name: dbsearch-tests
description: jsdom for the Python suite's DOM guards. NOT an app - see the note below.
//: #792. Fifteen selftest_*.py files drive a real surface through node, ten of them mounting
it in jsdom. They used to resolve jsdom out of `site/node_modules` - the Next.js MARKETING
SITE's devDependency tree - which is an undeclared coupling in both directions: the suite
depended on a package it never declared, and it only ever worked because somebody had run
`npm install` in site/ for unrelated frontend work. On a clean clone and in CI it was
simply absent, and every one of those guards returned a green skip.
Declaring it here fixes the coupling rather than the symptom. It also sidesteps a real
defect in the site's own lockfile (picomatch 2.3.2 vs 4.0.5, tracked separately): npm 11
tolerates that mismatch and npm 10 refuses it, so `npm ci --prefix site` passed locally and
failed in CI. The suite should not be able to break for a reason that belongs to the
jsdom is pinned EXACTLY, not with a caret. This is test infrastructure whose whole job is
to give the same answer twice; a minor bump that changes how a cascade or a media query
resolves would move guards without moving any code they guard.
